items.title: »Vi skal til bunds i det her«: Minister sætter gang i undersøgelse om mel lavet på korn fra forurenet lager
items.summary: En undersøgelse skal kaste lys over, hvorfor Fødevarestyrelsen sidste år tillod, at mel fra forurenet kornlager endte i butikkerne. Men flere partier er betænkelige ved, at styrelsen undersøger sig selv.
items.titleEn: ⁇ We need to get to the bottom of this  ⁇ : The Minister is launching an investigation into flour made from grain from contaminated stock

items.title: Historisk dom om folkedrab kan få betydning for sagen mod Israel
items.summary: Den Internationale Domstol har kendt Myanmar skyldig i folkedrab mod rohingyaerne. Det får betydning for domstolens kommende afgørelse om, hvorvidt Israel begik folkedrab i Gaza, siger eksperter.
items.titleEn: Historic genocide convictions could have implications for the case against Israel
items.summaryEn: The International Court of Justice has convicted Myanmar of genocide against the Rohingya. This will affect the court's upcoming ruling on whether Israel committed genocide in Gaza, experts say.

items.titleEn: Professor rejects fears of population displacement after the Prime Minister's statement
items.summaryEn: Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen (S) used in a podcast a term usually used by the far right. The unit list criticizes the prime minister for talking about population replacement and the professor rejects the theory.
